data.title: PTTEP volunteers help expand public green spaces through tree planting at Rot Fai Park
data.description: PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited (PTTEP) organised the “Give Grow Green” volunteer activity at Vachirabenjatas (Rot Fai) Park in Bangkok, where more than 60 PTTEP employee volunteers gained hands-on experience in tree planting, from learning proper techniques to planting over 300 trees of various species. This contribution helps expand urban green spaces and provide a pleasant, shaded environment for park visitors, while also encouraging employees to create shared value for society.

data.title: LG marks 38 years in Thailand, launches 'Make It Yours. Make It Easy.' campaign
data.description: LG Electronics (Thailand) Co Ltd, the global innovation leader in home appliances from South Korea, has reaffirmed its long-standing commitment to business excellence and community engagement in Thailand with the official launch of its 38th anniversary campaign under the concept "LG Make It Yours. Make It Easy."

data.title: CP AXTRA unveils 'Happy & Healthy Mall' strategy
data.description: Unveiling the “Happy & Healthy Mall” Strategy: Transforming Makro and Lotus’s retail locations into happy community spaces for people of all generations. Advance the development of 60 projects across 29 provinces nationwide in 2026–2027, marking one of the Company’s largest mall development and renovation programmes in recent years. Developing four Happy & Healthy Mall Models built on the core principle of “Understanding Each Community” to fit the unique context of every location nationwide.

data.title: TINT, Saskatchewan Sign Nuclear Cooperation MOU
data.description: TINT and the Government of Saskatchewan, Canada Sign MOU to Advance Nuclear Technology Collaboration, Workforce Development, and International Research Partnerships

data.title: S. Khonkaen Strengthens Entrée Brand with “Meet & Chips” Campaign Featuring Tle–FirstOne
data.description: S. Khonkaen Foods Public Company Limited (SORKON) continues to advance the marketing strategy of its Entrée brand through the “Entrée Meet & Chips: เติมโปรตีน ฟินคู่ชิปส์ with Tle & Firstone” campaign. The exclusive event offered selected campaign winners an opportunity to meet the brand’s two presenters up close, participate in special activities, and receive exclusive prizes in a fun-filled atmosphere that received an overwhelmingly warm response. The event further reinforced Entrée’s positioning as a high-protein snack brand that fits seamlessly into the lifestyles of today’s younger consumers.

data.title: TFM Posts Strong Q2 Growth, Declares THB 0.18 Interim Dividend
data.description: BANGKOK – 31 July 2026 – Thai Union Feedmill Public Company Limited, or TFM, reported strong operating results for the second quarter of 2026, with revenue increasing by 9.8% and net profit rising by 9.0% from the previous quarter. This performance brought the Company’s first-half sales revenue to THB 2.78 billion and net profit to THB 308 million, driven primarily by its shrimp feed business. TFM also announced an interim dividend payment of THB 0.18 per share, scheduled for 26 August 2026.

data.title: PAÑPURI Introduces Care Eau de Parfum REDEFINED.
data.description: PAÑPURI, the acclaimed Thai niche fragrance and holistic wellness brand, introduces Care Eau de Parfum , a new alcohol-free collection for skin and hair that offers a more intimate expression of fine fragrance. Designed to deliver lasting scent in a lighter, more breathable form, the collection brings together fragrance, daily ritual, and care for the body in one gesture.

data.title: BDMS Opens Bangkok-Phuket Cancer Institute
data.description: Phuket, Thailand – Bangkok Hospital Group in Phuket officially inaugurated the Bangkok-Phuket Cancer Institute at Bangkok Hospital Phuket, marking a significant milestone in advancing comprehensive cancer care under the “Care Beyond Cure” philosophy. The institute integrates the expertise and capabilities of Bangkok Hospital Phuket, Bangkok Hospital Siriroj, and Dibuk Hospital into a unified and integrated cancer care network for international patients.

data.title: TCMA and GIZ push low-carbon technologies to drive cement sector toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has expanded its partnership with Germany’s development agency, the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), to accelerate the adoption of low-carbon technologies in Thailand’s cement industry. The initiative, highlighted at the TCMA xGIZ at TCMA Technical Conference 2026, reflects a shift from policy commitments to implementation, under the theme: “#MadeInGermany: Cement Decarbonisation in Practice – Insights for Thailand”. The collaboration aims to transfer proven technologies and expertise from developed economies to support Thailand’s transition toward Net Zero emissions by 2050.

data.title: Bond Yields Move FX More Than Headlines: Here's Why
data.description: In the past, traders in the foreign exchange (forex) market would pay most of their attention to central banks, economies and politics. Although these three elements remain important, more traders are paying attention to yet another element – government bond yields.

data.title: True Corporation Reports Sixth Consecutive Quarter of Profitability
data.description: True Corporation announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026, delivering another quarter of profitability supported by topline recovery and disciplined financial management. Despite heightened macroeconomic headwinds, operational performance remained positive across all business segments. For the quarter, the Company reported Net Profit After Tax of THB 6.6 billion, while EBITDA reached THB 28.3 billion, increasing 13.5% year-on-year.

data.title: Risk-On or Risk-Off? How to Read Global Sentiment Before You Trade
data.description: Financial markets are not only affected by economic indicators and corporate performance but also by the sentiments of investors. Every day in trading markets, people decide whether they want to seek risk or avoid it. This is called risk-on and risk-off sentiment.

data.title: Central Bank Policy: Its Impact on the Currency Market
data.description: Central banks have an important influence on the foreign exchange market. Decisions regarding interest rates, policy statements, inflation projections and economic growth all influence the value of currencies relative to one another. In the forex market, understanding central bank policy is vital, as it is often the primary driver of currency movements.

data.title: Inflation Is Back: What the Next CPI Release Means for Traders
data.description: One theme that is making its return to the global financial markets is that of inflation. Following a long period during which there has been relative calm on the inflation front, rising pressures from commodity prices have forced traders to look at the prospects for inflation, central bank policy, and market conditions once again.

data.title: Building school food security through safe local production
data.description: Every morning before the school bell rings, students at Ban Tham Hin Border Patrol Police School gather at the henhouse and in the school’s home-grown vegetable plots. They refill water containers, scatter feed, count and record the eggs, observe the hens, and carefully collect fresh eggs and vegetables that will become part of their lunch only a few hours later.

data.title: WAVE appoints Tom Kruesopon as CEO
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Aug 3, 2026 – WAVE Exponential Public Company Limited (WAVE) has officially appointed Julapas"Tom"Kruesopon as its Chief Executive Officer, unveiling a turnaround strategy aimed at transforming the company into a leader in enhancing quality of life for Thai people.

data.title: PTTEP announces first-half performance of 2026 and interim dividend payment at 4.50 baht per share
data.description: Bangkok, 31 July 2026 – PTTEP announced its operational progress for the first half of 2026, maintaining natural gas production at full capacity to help mitigate the energy crisis arising from the ongoing Middle East conflict and to safeguard the country’s energy security. During the period, the company contributed over 27,700 million baht to the government to support national development and deliver continuous shareholder returns, with an approved interim dividend of 4.50 baht per share.

data.title: Understanding de-dollarisation
data.description: The past year, 2025, marked one of the most volatile and structurally transformative periods in the history of modern global finance. We witnessedgold hit an All-Time High28 times, while the US Dollar Index (DXY) plummeted severely by-9.5%ina single year—one of its steepest annual declines. These phenomena are not coincidental; they are the result of macroeconomic forces that have been building for decades.

data.title: i-Tail reports strong H1, 20.6% sales rise
data.description: BANGKOK, July 30, 2026 – i-Tail Corporation Public Company Limited (ITC), a global leader in the pet food industry, announced first-half sales in 2026 of US$316 million, up 20.6% year-on-year. In Thai baht terms, sales rose 15.1% to 10.04 billion baht. Building on this strong performance, the board of directors approved an interim dividend of 0.55 baht per share, representing a high payout ratio of 96.2%.

data.title: Aura Wellness Unites 9 Leading Thai Entrepreneurs for "Aura Career Camp," Shaping Thailand's Next-Generation Workforce
data.description: A two-day intensive business camp selected 50 top students from over 1,000 applicants, offeringthem a firsthand look at the realities of the working world from entrepreneurs and executives — reinforcing that investing in people is the foundation of the country's long-term growth.

data.title: Samut Sakhon and Thainakarin Hospitals Strengthen Kidney Transplant Network Via Seminar
data.description: SAMUT SAKHON, Thailand – July 20, 2026 – Samut Sakhon Hospital, in collaboration with Thainakarin Hospital, hosted the Kidney Transplant Program Preparation Seminar at the Sawat Raiwa Conference Room, 7th Floor, Emergency Building, Samut Sakhon Hospital. The event brought together more than 60 physicians, nurses and multidisciplinary healthcare professionals to advance the development of kidney transplantation services and strengthen regional healthcare capacity.

data.title: DITP and RX BITEC Present TILOG – LOGISTIX 2026 Empowering Thailand's Supply Chains for Global Trade
data.description: The Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP), Ministry of Commerce, in collaboration with RX BITEC and logistics industry partners, is set to host TILOG – LOGISTIX 2026, ASEAN’s most comprehensive exhibition on technologies and services for warehouse management, loading, packing, material handling, and transportation from 19–21 August 2026, 10am–6pm, at Hall 98, BITEC Bangkok.

data.title: Thailand hosts high-level talks on ASEAN vaccine security
data.description: Thailand, through the National Vaccine Institute (NVI), in collaboration with the Ministry of Public Health and the ASEAN Secretariat, convened the ASEAN Meeting on the ASEAN Vaccine Security and Self-Reliance (AVSSR): Continuing Regional Efforts and Transition from 2021-2025 to 2026-2030, followed by the AVSSR Vaccine Human Resource Development Programme under the theme “ASEAN Vaccine Security: Pooled Power, Pooled Procurement.”

data.title: Huawei Cloud Unveils Agentic Infrastructure and CodeArts Agent OBT in Thailand
data.description: Huawei Cloud has hosted Huawei Cloud Summit Thailand 2026, bringing together leaders from government, business, industry partners, and the technology community to exchange views on how cloud and AI can support Thailand’s digital economy. During the event, Huawei Cloud announced “Huawei Cloud Agentic Infrastructure: Now Available for Thailand” and officially launched Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent Open Beta Testing (OBT) in the country.

data.title: CP LAND launches ‘Pri-d’ to empower residents and partners.
data.description: C .P.LAND Public Company Limited, Thailand's leading property developers under the Charoen Pokphand (C.P) Group, has launched the Pri-d Privilege Programme, a customer relationship management (CRM) platform designed to connect residents, customers, businesspartnersand services within a single ecosystem.

data.title: BEM Reports 60% EMV Contactless Growth, Backs Govt Common Ticketing System
data.description: BEM has announced a significant increase in the adoption of EMV Contactless payments, with usage rising by 60% following the full implementation of EMV payment acceptance across the MRT Blue Line and Purple Line. The company reaffirmed its readiness to support the Government’s Common Ticketing Policy and the upcoming 17–45 baht integrated fare scheme, while continuing to work closely with the Mass Rapid Transit Authority of Thailand (MRTA) and Krungthai Bank to further enhance the system’s efficiency and service standards.

data.title: Thailand Privilege Visa 2026: What the latest promotions mean for long-term residents
data.description: As Thailand enters the third quarter of 2026, several Thailand Privilege promotions are approaching key deadlines as the country’s long-stay landscape continues to evolve. With visa policies and residence options changing, foreign residents are increasingly looking for longer-term solutions that offer greater stability, flexibility and predictability when planning their future in Thailand.

data.title: Bangkok Komatsu Sales unveils new 20-tonne hydraulic excavators
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Bangkok Komatsu Sales Co Ltd (BKS), the sole authorised distributor of Komatsu construction machinery in Thailand for more than 70 years under Siam Motors Group, recently officially launched the all-new Komatsu PC200-11M2 and Komatsu PC210-11M2 20-tonne hydraulic excavators. The new generation machines are designed to meet the evolving demands of today's construction industry, delivering outstanding performance, durability, cost efficiency, and renowned Japanese quality while reaffirming the company's long-standing commitment to providing innovative solutions and exceptional customer support across Thailand.

data.title: CMA launches “The NEXT Chapter” with 5 Engines to accelerate cement industry toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has advanced its strategy, “The NEXT Chapter to Net Zero 2050,” through five key implementation pillars - “5 Engines to Net Zero” - under the theme ‘Accelerating Collaborative Action towards Net Zero 2050.’ The initiative aims to accelerate the transition of Thailand’s cement industry toward a low-carbon future, while elevating its role as a Climate Solution Partner, in alignment with the Thailand 2050 Net Zero Cement and Concrete Roadmap, a shared industry commitment.

data.title: Central Pattana Leverages Insights for 'Mom Moments' Mother's Day Campaign
data.description: In remembrance of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, The Queen Mother’s boundless compassioninspired by her royalquote“Ilove being a mother the most”,the love and bond between mothers and children will be conveyed through nationwide experiences.

data.title: TAT Celebrates UNESCO Status for Wat Phra Mahathat with Year-Round Campaign
data.description: Bangkok, 27 July 2026– The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) is celebrating the inscription of Wat Phra MahathatWoramahawihanin Nakhon Si Thammarat on the UNESCO World Heritage List as Thailand’s ninth World Heritage property and sixth cultural property. TAT is carrying this historic recognition forward through the“ The Twelve Sacred DiscoveriesNakhon Si Thammarat: A Journey to World Heritage”campaign, a year-round programme inviting visitors to discover the site’s living Buddhist heritage across the seasons.

data.title: Betagro at Grand Halal Bangkok 2026: Serving Halal Food to the World
data.description: Bangkok – 24 July 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, led by Sunisa Maud-En, Managing Director, Quality Assurance and Quality Management Office (1st from left), together with Sorached Charoenthammaporn, Assistant Vice President - Global Trading (4th from left), welcomed Samarn Kopitak, Subcommittee Member of the Halal Product Inspection, The Central Islamic Council of Thailand (CICOT), and Advisor to the Sheikhul Islam of Thailand (2nd from left), and delegation, on the occasion of Betagro’s participation for the second consecutive year in the international halal trade exhibition, Grand Halal Bangkok 2026, held from July 15–17, 2026, at the Bangkok International Trade and Exhibition Centre (BITEC), Bangna.

data.title: Thai FDA, Poland’s URPL advance landmark regulatory pact
data.description: Thailand’s Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Poland’s Office for Registration of Medicinal Products (URPL) are advancing plans to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation in health product regulation, knowledge exchange, and capacity building between the two agencies.

data.title: SEIKO: A 145-Year Modernisation
data.description: While precision is undoubtedly the heart of any timepiece, for 145 years Seiko’s memorable craftsmanship heritage has lived by a single, enduring ethos: to be ‘Always one step ahead of the rest’.

data.title: CC DOUBLE O names Nadech Kugimiya first brand presenter
data.description: CC DOUBLE O is marking a major milestone in its two-decade history with the appointment of Nadech Kugimiya as its first brand presenter and the launch of “THE NEW BASIC – Impossible to Ignore”, a campaign designed to broaden the appeal of the brand’s signature bird-logo collection.

data.title: Webull Thailand & Gaysorn Village Partner for Webull Prime Experience
data.description: Webull Securities (Thailand) Co., Ltd. ("Webull Thailand"), a subsidiary of Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL), the owner of the Webull trading platform, announced its partnership with Gaysorn Village under the concept “Invest Like a Prime. Live Like a Legend”. The collaboration elevates the experience for Webull Prime members by connecting the world of investing with a refined lifestyle, a curated community, and exclusive privileges through The Gaysorn Legend, Gaysorn Village’s exclusive premium membership community.
